name: THE COLLAPSE AT LAMBDA 2, as arithmetic. Every exponent from 3 to 23 reaches a unit group of exponent 2 only through gcd(n, 2), and the 21 exponents land on just 2 distinct value(s): 1, 2. The kernel computes each gcd rather than trusting a table.
